name: comp-244
title: Tiny Thumb Slider
blurb: Slider with a minimal, tiny thumb for precise inputs.
description: A slider with a very small thumb handle, suitable when compact styling is required.
use_when: A design needs minimal visual footprint for the slider thumb.
avoid_when: Touch interfaces where small targets are hard to hit.
a11y: Small target size may be difficult to hit precisely. Consider touch device constraints.
